yaml:
scenario: SIRS_Screening_ACCP_SCCM
version: 1.0.0
description: Screen for SIRS criteria based on 1992 ACCP/SCCM guidelines
signals:
  Temp:
    ref: body_temperature
    expected_unit: C
    description: Body temperature
    concept_id: 4302666
    concept_code: '386725007'
    vocabulary_id: SNOMED
  HR:
    ref: heart_rate
    expected_unit: bpm
    description: Heart rate
    concept_id: 3027018
    concept_code: 8867-4
    vocabulary_id: LOINC
  RR:
    ref: respiratory_rate
    expected_unit: bpm
    description: Respiratory rate
    concept_id: 3024171
    concept_code: 9279-1
    vocabulary_id: LOINC
  WBC:
    ref: white_blood_cell_count
    expected_unit: x10^9/L
    description: White blood cell count
    concept_id: 4298431
    concept_code: '767002'
    vocabulary_id: SNOMED
trends:
  temp_current:
    expr: last(Temp)
    description: Current temperature
  hr_current:
    expr: last(HR)
    description: Current heart rate
  rr_current:
    expr: last(RR)
    description: Current respiratory rate
  wbc_current:
    expr: last(WBC)
    description: Current WBC count
logic:
  fever:
    when: temp_current > 38
    severity: low
    description: Temperature above 38C
  hypothermia:
    when: temp_current < 36
    severity: low
    description: Temperature below 36C
  tachycardia:
    when: hr_current > 90
    severity: low
    description: Heart rate above 90 bpm
  tachypnea:
    when: rr_current > 20
    severity: low
    description: Respiratory rate above 20 bpm
  leukocytosis:
    when: wbc_current > 12
    severity: low
    description: WBC above 12 x10^9/L
  leukopenia:
    when: wbc_current < 4
    severity: low
    description: WBC below 4 x10^9/L
  sirs_criteria:
    when: (fever OR hypothermia) AND (tachycardia OR tachypnea OR leukocytosis OR
      leukopenia)
    severity: high
    description: At least two SIRS criteria met
outputs:
  decision:
    sirs_positive:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.sirs_criteria
      description: Patient meets SIRS criteria
    has_fever:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.fever
      description: Patient has fever
    has_tachycardia:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.tachycardia
      description: Patient has tachycardia
    has_tachypnea:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.tachypnea
      description: Patient has tachypnea
    has_leukocyte_abnormality:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.leukocytosis
      description: Abnormal WBC count
  features:
    temperature:
      type: float
      from: trends.temp_current
      description: Current body temperature
    heart_rate:
      type: float
      from: trends.hr_current
      description: Current heart rate
    respiratory_rate:
      type: float
      from: trends.rr_current
      description: Current respiratory rate
    wbc_count:
      type: float
      from: trends.wbc_current
      description: Current WBC count
  evidence:
    timestamp:
      type: datetime
      expr: evaluation_time()
      description: When this evaluation was performed
